name: dRonin
readmeExcerpt:
dRonin is an autopilot/flight controller firmware for controllers in the OpenPilot/Tau Labs family.  It's aimed at a variety of use cases: acro/racing, autonomous flight, and vehicle research.

dRonin is production ready and released under the GPL.

See [dronin.org](http://dronin.org) for more details.

## Supported Targets

### Full Support

- AeroQuad32
- [BrainFPV](http://brainfpv.com/)
- [BrainFPV RE1](http://brainfpv.com/) (no nav sensors on board)
- [DTFAir DTFc](http://www.dtfuhf.com/) (no nav sensors on board)  Also Colibri Race / TBS PowerCube.
- [DTFAir Seppuku](http://www.dtfuhf.com/)
- [Lumenier Lux](http://www.getfpv.com/lumenier-lux-flight-controller.html) (only V1, and no nav sensors are on board)
- OpenPilot Revolution (including many race-only variants)
- PikoBLX and clones
- Quantec Quanton
- Seriously Pro Racing F3 EVO (only the EVO variant) and clones
- Tau Labs Sparky
- [Tau Labs Sparky2](https://github.com/TauLabs/TauLabs/wiki/Sparky2)

### Limited Support

- [Team Black Sheep Colibri / Gemini hexcopter](http://team-blacksheep.com/products/prod:gemini)  (supported by Quanton target)

releases.name: dRonin 2018-07-29 release ("Inconceivable")
releases.body:
Hello world: it's time for another dRonin release, of our "inconceivable" development effort. There's exciting stuff in here, including the first flight-ready LQR control system (no longer are we stuck only with PID!)

Jump ahead to: Changes / Errata & troubleshooting

**Major changes since last release:**

As always, there's many small bug and usability fixes. But beyond that:

* Core controls and functionality improvements:
  * **LQG (Linear Quadratic Gaussian) control added as an alternative to PID**. To use, autotune and then configure LQG or LQGLeveling flight modes.
  * Increased maximum yaw axis PID limits, as some real crafts with small propellers were hitting them.
  * Introduced ability to limit the maximum speed commanded from individual motors (i.e. artificially limit kV to run 4S motors on 6S)
  * Ability added to specify thrust mode separately for each stabilization bank
  * Improvements made to control input smoothing/interpolation
  * Autotune now calculates hangtime and vertical / altitude hold control constants
  * **Flipover mode**
    * Drives motors on one "edge" to flip the vehicle back upright
    * "To configure, configure a quad with 3D out

aiSummary.oneLiner: An advanced autopilot and flight controller firmware for multirotors, planes, and helicopters.
aiSummary.whatItDoes: dRonin is a comprehensive flight controller firmware derived from the OpenPilot and Tau Labs architectures. It is engineered to stabilize and navigate a wide spectrum of unmanned aerial vehicles (UAVs), including quadcopters, hexacopters, fixed-wing planes, and traditional helicopters. The firmware offers production-ready flight stabilization, featuring an advanced autotune system that automatically calculates optimal PID and LQG (Linear Quadratic Gaussian) control constants. It supports a broad range of hardware targets and is designed for diverse applications ranging from acrobatic drone racing to autonomous waypoint navigation.
keyFeatures: Multi-vehicle support: Capable of stabilizing and controlling quads, hexas, planes, and traditional helicopters.
Advanced autotuning: Automatically calculates optimal PID and advanced LQG control constants for highly stable flight characteristics.
Broad hardware compatibility: Fully supports a wide array of flight controller boards, including BrainFPV, DTFc, and Quanton.
Autonomous navigation: Includes features for programmed waypoint following and GPS-assisted flight modes.
Flipover mode: Includes specialized recovery algorithms to flip a crashed vehicle back upright using motor bursts.

useCases.title: Acrobatic Drone Racing
useCases.description: Provides ultra-low latency control and locked-in performance necessary for high-speed FPV racing.

useCases.title: Autonomous Flight Missions
useCases.description: Executes pre-programmed GPS waypoint missions for applications like aerial surveying or automated videography.

useCases.title: Experimental Vehicle Research
useCases.description: Serves as a robust, open-source platform for aerospace researchers testing novel flight control algorithms or airframes.

useCases.title: Custom Multirotor Builds
useCases.description: Allows hobbyists to configure and fine-tune advanced flight parameters for non-standard aerial setups.

aiSummary.whoIsItFor: dRonin is for drone hobbyists, FPV racers, and aerospace researchers who require a flexible, highly stable, and open-source flight controller for custom UAV builds.
aiSummary.gettingStarted: Review the documentation at dronin.org and compile using the provided Makefile.
